items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Was there a leader that you recall, of this band? ... Oh, yeah, his name was Joe Lichter.

ctx.x: Vaudeville, I see. Was there a leader that you recall, of this band?

Oh, yeah, his name was Joe Lichter. He was a man originally from Milwaukee, who had been a theatre conductor and a theatre musician most of his life. He'd done a lot of work in Chicago and he came back to Milwaukee. And he had the orchestra conductor at the Strand Theatre there for several years, and then when the theatres were getting a bit shaky, he switched to going to a ballroom, because he was basically a kind of a jazz player himself.
